title: G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting — Atlanta, Georgia (US presidency, Rubio hosting)
source: NEWS: US Department of State, Office of the Spokesperson release 'The United States to Host G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta, Georgia' (state.gov/releases/office-of-the-spokesperson/2026/05/...), which reads that Secretary of State Marco Rubio will host the meeting in Atlanta on October 30-31, 2026; a follow-up release 'Media Logistics for the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta, Georgia' (same path, 2026/07/) confirms the meeting is still live as of July 2026. DIRECT FETCH BLOCKED — state.gov returned HTTP 403 to this lane on 2026-09-15 (logged in the proposing ledger's probe-ref.blocked), so the prefix is NEWS: and not a self-confirmed primary read, per the blocked-sources rule in docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md. Corroborated independently by Atlanta News First (2026-05-19), Hoodline (2026-05) and the US Embassy China mirror of the same State release. Also filed estimate because the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for a State Department press release, and because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the DATE is not in doubt. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: PROPOSED BECAUSE IT KILLS A SWITCH ON THE PROPOSING LEDGER, not because a foreign-ministers' meeting is tradable on its own. us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10's initial research (2026-09-04) rested one of its five kill switches on the claim that the natural venue to extend China's rare-earth export-control suspension — APEC Shenzhen, 2026-11-18/19 — sits eight days AFTER the 2026-11-10 deadline, i.e. that no pre-deadline venue exists. That claim was written from LEADER-level meetings only. This is a ministerial venue eight to eleven days BEFORE the deadline, and it is the third of three: g20-trade-ministerial-milwaukee-2026-09-30 and g20-fmcbg-bangkok-2026-10-15 are already in this calendar and also pre-date 11/10. Caveat carried honestly: foreign ministers are not the trade channel — the US-China export-control file runs Bessent/Greer to He Lifeng/Wang Wentao, not Rubio to Wang Yi — so this venue is a bridging OPPORTUNITY, not a scheduled negotiation, and nothing here is date-keyed action. Filed `low` impact: a G20 FMM has no scheduled market-moving release and the G20 ministerials already in this calendar carry the same grade. Discovered during the us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-15); proposing ledger: docs/research/events/us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10.md.
